form201.incidentName: FICTIONAL EXERCISE - Maple Ridge missing adult with dementia
form201.situationSummary: FICTIONAL ILLUSTRATION ONLY; not an operational plan. Ellis Linden, fictional 74-year-old adult with dementia, wandered from a residence at Residence / IPP, 1 Trail Lane, fictional Maple Ridge, MA; last seen there at 0600 July 18. Staging: Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP). Command staff: ICP, county community center, 50 Civic Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (1.5 km west of IPP). Wearing a blue shirt and tan trousers; may not respond to calls. No verified clues at 0800. Summer forecast 27-31 C, humid, light wind; shaded woodland, uneven trails, creek edges and ticks. No aircraft. Koster hub/spokes/rim: protect the residence/last-known-point hub; stage away from the IPP; search travel spokes promptly; observe likely rim exits, then search bounded areas and familiar attractors. G1 splits into four-person G1-A/G1-B on routes A/B; four-person G2-A takes route C, all 0715-1000. Three G2 support searchers await K3 at staging; one G2 member and three released K3 support remain reserve until the eight-person G2 grid reassembles at 1030. G1 reassembles eight for attractors then grid. All names, agencies, geography, contacts, capabilities and approvals are invented.

objectives: Mitigate all hazards to responders and the general public to an acceptable level, with particular attention to heat stress and tick exposure, throughout the entire duration of the incident.
By 1000, complete hasty searches of the three most likely travel corridors from IPP to containment boundary at least once.
By 0800, establish containment of both likely egress points and maintain it through 1900.
By 1700, search the high-probability inner 25% zone to a coverage target of approximately 1.
By 1200, search all three familiar attractors and associated hazard points within 1 km of IPP.

form202.commandEmphasis: FICTIONAL EXERCISE ONLY. Prioritize responder/public safety and protect IPP scent. Hasty-search likely travel corridors and familiar attractors; maintain containment. Search the high-probability inner 25% zone to coverage approximately 1; reassess heat and tick hazards.
form202.situationalAwareness: 0800 July 18, 2026 exercise snapshot. Fictional Ellis Linden, 74-year-old adult with dementia, last seen 0600 July 18 at Residence / IPP, 1 Trail Lane, fictional Maple Ridge, MA. Wearing a blue shirt and tan trousers; may hide or not answer. No verified clues. Forecast 27-31 C, humid, light wind; shaded woodland, uneven trails and creek edges. Staging: Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP). Separate command post: ICP, county community center, 50 Civic Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (1.5 km west of IPP). Supply / recovery base colocated at ICP for water resupply and recovery coordination. All teams report directly to Ops; no branches, divisions or groups. 36 human field searchers INCLUDE four handlers; four dogs are equipment, not people. Six IMT at ICP, county community center, 50 Civic Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (1.5 km west of IPP); IC Avery Wren is Sheriff of Fictional Pine County Sheriff's Office. No aircraft. Seven teams initially active; Ops must reassess span before later launches and stagger/pause work if direct supervision becomes unsafe; eight teams is not assumed manageable. Koster hub/spokes/rim guides prioritization, not a guarantee of containment. No negative search guarantees absence. Summer heat and ticks require continuous reassessment.

entries.mitigations: Use repellent per label, long trousers and buddy tick checks at 1000 and demob; promptly remove attached ticks with proper tool and report exposures to MEDL.
Maintain buddy contact, deliberate footing and suitable boots; avoid unstable banks and water entry. Stop and report unsafe crossings; use an alternate route authorized by Ops.

entries.hazardsRisks: Summer heat / dehydration / canine heat stress
entries.mitigations: ICP water resupply by 0900; hourly hydration/electrolyte checks for all field teams. Mandatory shaded rest and heat-illness checks from 1300, plus rest as needed; observation buddies alternate 1300-1320/1320-1340 in adjacent shade, retaining buddy contact and uninterrupted observation; repeat at least hourly. Canine 20-minute work/cooling cycles; handlers monitor dogs continuously. Stop work for heat illness signs; notify MEDL, cool safely and request assistance.

form208.generalRequirements: FICTIONAL EXERCISE ONLY. All personnel briefed at 0700. Stop work for unsafe conditions; immediately notify Ops and Safety. 30-minute radio/accountability checks. MEDL coordinates from ICP, county community center, 50 Civic Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (1.5 km west of IPP); aid supplies at staging. Emergency traffic takes priority.

openActionItems.item: First tick check: ALL teams complete and report buddy tick checks by 1000; Safety verifies completion; MEDL tracks exposures.

Hourly hydration/electrolyte checks for all field teams; replenish ICP drinking water by 0900 and arrange field/canine water delivery requests through simulated support service. Planning and Safety verify every team.

MANDATORY shaded rest break and heat-illness check from 1300 for all field teams, supervised remotely by Safety/MEDL at ICP; observation buddies alternate rest 1300-1320/1320-1340 in adjacent shade with continuous observation and buddy contact.

End-shift demob: Safety begins tick/hydration checks at 1830 and verifies completion before release; account for all 42 people and four canines, complete task debriefs, equipment return and safe-travel checks. Maintain paired containment posts through 1900; verify continuing containment/relief needs with Ops before releasing anyone.

medicalPlan.emergencyProcedures: FICTIONAL EXERCISE ONLY; do not call example numbers. For a real emergency use the actual local emergency number. Exercise: announce emergency traffic on MR SAR 1, give task/location, injury and access; MEDL coordinates from ICP; staging aid post is a supplies/cache and rendezvous location, not an additional staffed team. Ops alerts MEDL, pauses nearby work, requests the simulated BLS service and arranges ground extraction and ambulance rendezvous at staging. No aircraft assigned. Do not move a patient unless needed for immediate safety.
